answer: Each agent runs one sluice gate on a river delta channel, locking 85 credits as bond. The operator keeps a quill logbook and pays a gate fee: first gate 32, kth 32+6(k-1), 1000th 6026. Each tide window the operator works it and logs the water delta. An auditor recomputes the expected delta from the tide table; a mismatch over 5 percent or a reused logbook burns the bond. A hired-hands ring fails because the auditor compares quill handwriting and burns books written by one hand. An honest operator pays 32 once. For 1000 fake gates fees total 3,029,000 plus 85,000 locked.
